item.title: Can my credit card help if my vacation is affected by a military conflict or war?
item.description: If your travels are affected by a military conflict or war, your credit card may be able to help you navigate such an event. Here's how.

item.title: Last chance: Earn 5 Marriott free night awards with the Bonvoy Boundless's highest bonus
item.description: Check out the current welcome offers across Marriott Bonvoy credit cards from Chase and American Express, including limited-time elevated bonus offers.

item.title: No snow, no problem: 5 backup Western winter getaways beyond ski resorts to book with points and miles
item.description: If you're concerned about snow conditions on your upcoming ski trip, consider booking a backup trip to one of these Western destinations.

item.title: Peak bloom date announced: Best time to see DC’s cherry blossoms in 2026
item.description: The National Park Service predicts peak bloom will be between March 29 and April 1, but, depending on the weather, blossoms can be seen both before and after those dates.

item.title: Atmos Rewards Summit Visa card review: Stellar value for more than just Alaska and Hawaiian loyalists
item.description: The Atmos Rewards Summit is a premium card for Alaska Airlines and Hawaiian Airlines flyers, but it holds value for many types of travelers.

item.title: No headphones? United passengers could be barred from flying
item.description: United Airlines now has a specific policy against listening to video or audio content without using headphones as part of an update to its official terms.

item.title: The best cards for trip cancellation and interruption insurance — and what it actually covers
item.description: Select credit cards may reimburse your prepaid, nonrefundable expenses if you have to cancel or interrupt a trip for certain covered unavoidable reasons.

item.title: Earn up to 90,000 AAdvantage miles with a Citi / AAdvantage credit card
item.description: Citi's AAdvantage credit card lineup come with solid welcome bonus offers for more AA miles to use on American Airlines flights. Here's what to know.

item.title: ExpertFlyer unveils 330-day American systemwide upgrade availability and detailed seat maps
item.description: ExpertFlyer launches 330-day American systemwide upgrade availability and a new partnership for detailed seat maps — but membership rates are increasing.
